biothings.name: systemic lupus erythematosus
biothings.definition: An autoimmune multi-organ disease typically associated with vasculopathy and autoantibody production. Most patients have antinuclear antibodies (ANA). The presence of anti-dsDNA or anti-Smith antibodies are highly-specific. [NCIT:P378]

opentargets.name: systemic lupus erythematosus
opentargets.description: An autoimmune multi-organ disease typically associated with vasculopathy and autoantibody production. Most patients have antinuclear antibodies (ANA). The presence of anti-dsDNA or anti-Smith antibodies are highly-specific.

opentargets.name: autosomal systemic lupus erythematosus type 16
opentargets.description: An instance of systemic lupus erythematosus (disease) that is caused by mutations in DNASE1L3.

opentargets.name: systemic lupus erythematosus related to C1QA
opentargets.description: Any systemic lupus erythematosus in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the C1QA gene.

opentargets.name: cutaneous lupus erythematosus
opentargets.description: An autoimmune disorder that manifests as different lupus-specific skin disorders; it can occur with systemic lupus erythematosus, or as a singular disease.

opentargets.name: lupus erythematosus
opentargets.description: An autoimmune, connective tissue chronic inflammatory disorder affecting the skin, joints, kidneys, lungs, heart, and the peripheral blood cells. It is more commonly seen in women than men. Variants include discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus.
